samples.summary: Every other collapsed-caret style write in `EditorAPI` bypasses the new trailing-edge guard and re-arms the link
samples.evidence: The new helper's own doc comment (caret-style.ts:63-65) states that "every caller that stores a caret-derived style has to ask this before doing so, or typing silently extends the link". Only `clearInlineFormatting` (editor.ts:3364-3372) asks. `applyStyleImpl`'s collapsed branch — `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` at editor.ts:1170 — is the write path for the toolbar Bold/Italic/Underline/color/font-size buttons (`applyStyle`, editor.ts:3342) and for `stepSelectionFontSize` (editor.ts:1283). At a link's trailing edge `getSelectionStyleImpl()` returns the link run's style *including* `href`, and the merge ignores any prior pending state, so it (a) grafts the link onto the next typed run and (b) discards an `href: undefined` exit that `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` or the brand-new `clearInlineFormatting` override just armed. Concrete repro: caret at the trailing edge of a link → Cmd+\ (exit armed by the new code) → click Bold in the toolbar → type — the typed text is inside the hyperlink again, defeating the fix this diff adds. Note the keyboard twin `TextEditor.toggleStyle` (text-editor.ts:3497) does merge pending (`{ ...visual, ...resolved }`) and therefore keeps the exit, so the two surfaces also disagree.

samples.summary: `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` returns false when an empty-text href residue run follows the link, so no exit is armed at the visual end of the link
samples.evidence: `return !(next && next.style.href === inline.style.href);` treats any following run carrying the same href as "the link continues", including a zero-length residue run. Such residues demonstrably exist in this codebase — `getLinkAtCursor` in both editor.ts:3750 and text-box-editor.ts:1259 has an explicit "Skip an empty-text href residue at the boundary" branch. When one sits between the link and plain text, a caret at the link's visual trailing edge reports `false`, so neither `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` nor the new Clear-formatting override arms the exit and the next typed character extends the hyperlink. Logic is relocated verbatim from the old private `TextEditor.isAtLinkTrailingEdge`, so it is pre-existing, but it is now the single shared guard three call sites depend on.

samples.summary: The `prev.href === undefined` re-arm ignores the pending style's anchor, so a stale pending exit can unlink text at an unrelated caret
samples.evidence: `const prev = this.pending?.get();` (text-editor.ts:3439, mirrored at editor.ts:3365) reads only the pending *style*; `PendingStyle.get()` (pending-style.ts:20) does not expose or check the anchor, while `consumeForInsert` (pending-style.ts:30) discards mismatched anchors. Clear formatting then re-anchors that stale `href: undefined` to the current caret (`pending.set(..., this.cursor.position)`), so if the caret reached a position inside a hyperlink by a path that does not clear pending (e.g. `EditorAPI.restoreLocalCursor`, editor.ts:4338, which calls `cursor.moveTo` without `pending.clear()`), Clear formatting there will split the next typed character out of the link instead of leaving it linked — the opposite of the intent stated for the inside-a-link case.

finding.summary: Dropping `href` from CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE leaves an empty-inline href residue unclearable by any command
finding.evidence: `link-run.ts:27-31` documents that `normalizeInlines` leaves an `href` residue on a fully-emptied paragraph, and `findLinkRunAt` deliberately refuses to anchor on an empty-text inline (`inlines[i].text.length > 0` at link-run.ts:44). `removeLink` (editor.ts:3724, text-box-editor.ts:1237) is built on `findLinkRunAt`, so it no-ops on such a run. Until this change, Clear formatting was the one command that stripped that stale `href`; with `href` removed from `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` neither command touches it. Worse, on a collapsed caret in that paragraph `applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:1170) stores `{ ...caretInlineStyle(...), ...CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE }`, and `caretInlineStyle` has no residue guard (caret-style.ts:106-112), so the pending style now carries the residual `href` and the next typed characters become a hyperlink the user never created. `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` cannot help: an empty run fails its `position.offset > start` test.

verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the repository. `href` is genuinely absent from CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE (types.ts:300-315). The empty-inline href residue is genuinely produced by normalizeInlines, whose all-empty fallback deletes only `image` from the fallback style and keeps `href` (block-helpers.ts:105-111), reachable from applyDeleteText (block-helpers.ts:164) by simply deleting all text in a link-only paragraph. findLinkRunAt refuses to anchor on it (`inlines[i].text.length > 0`, link-run.ts:44, documented at link-run.ts:26-31), and removeLink returns early when findLinkRunAt yields undefined (editor.ts:3724-3725), so Remove hyperlink no-ops. The range clear path cannot reach it either (no non-empty range exists in an emptied paragraph). The collapsed-caret path does propagate the residue: applyStyleImpl stores `{ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }` (editor.ts:1170) and getSelectionStyleImpl delegates to caretInlineStyle (editor.ts:1163-1165), which returns `{ ...defaults, ...inline.style }` with no empty-text guard (caret-style.ts:106-110), so the pending style carries the residual href, which consumeForInsert then writes onto the typed characters (pending-style.ts:34-40). The new `exitsLink` guard cannot compensate because isAtLinkTrailingEdge requires `position.offset > start` (caret-style.ts:80), false for a zero-length inline. No `already-guarded`, `not-present`, or `out-of-scope` ground applies: this is wrong runtime behavior / a broken invariant, which is this lens's lane.

mergedFrom.summary: Only the trailing edge is guarded: at the *leading* edge of a link the toolbar clear seeds pending with the link's href and extends the link backwards

finding.summary: New link-trailing-edge guard is bolted onto `clearInlineFormatting` only; every other caller of `applyStyleImpl`'s collapsed-caret branch still re-arms the link from the caret style
finding.evidence: `applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:1170) stores `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)`. `getSelectionStyleImpl()` is the raw caret style, which at a link's trailing edge is the link run's style **including `href`**, and the prior pending state is NOT merged in — so any pending `href: undefined` armed by `exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge` is discarded. The diff patches only the `clearInlineFormatting` entry (editor.ts:3364-3372). The bypassing call sites are `applyStyle: applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:3342 — toolbar Bold/Italic/color/etc.) and `stepSelectionFontSizeImpl`'s collapsed branch (editor.ts:1283). Concretely: click the caret at the end of a hyperlink (mousedown clears pending), click toolbar Bold, type a character — the pending style carries the link's `href`, so `consumeForInsert` writes it onto the new text and the hyperlink silently grows. That is exactly the failure mode the new override exists to prevent, reachable through the sibling toolbar buttons. (Pre-existing shape, but it is the path around the new guard.)

verdict.reason: The described code exists as quoted and the bypass is reachable. editor.ts:1170 stores `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` with no merge of prior pending state, and getSelectionStyleImpl -> caretInlineStyle returns the run's full style including `href` at a link's trailing edge (caret-style.ts:106-111; its own comment at caret-style.ts:60-68 says every caret-style storer must consult isAtLinkTrailingEdge). The new trailing-edge override is confined to the clearInlineFormatting closure (editor.ts:3362-3372); `applyStyle: applyStyleImpl` (editor.ts:3342) and stepSelectionFontSizeImpl's collapsed branch (editor.ts:1283) reach the same pending.set with no check. The overwrite is consequential, not theoretical: exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge is only invoked on Space (text-editor.ts:981), Enter (text-editor.ts:2608/2641) and paste (text-editor.ts:4171); applySplitBlock gives the post-Enter block an empty inline carrying the link style (block-helpers.ts:275-277), so Enter at a link end (pending armed href: undefined) followed by a toolbar Bold click re-arms `href` and pending.consumeForInsert (pending-style.ts:34-40) writes it onto the next typed text, defeating the behavior asserted at test/view/link-trailing-edge.test.ts:177-187. No pending-clearing guard fires on toolbar style clicks (pending.clear() sites are cursor-move/blur/undo paths, e.g. editor.ts:1130), so I cannot name a guard, absence, or scope ground to refute.
